类 ExecutableMemberDocImpl

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.tools.javadoc.DocImpl

  • 所有已实现的接口:

    直接已知子类:

    public abstract class ExecutableMemberDocImpl
extends MemberDocImpl
implements ExecutableMemberDoc
    Represents a method or constructor of a java class.

    This is NOT part of any supported API. If you write code that depends on this, you do so at your own risk. This code and its internal interfaces are subject to change or deletion without notice.

    从以下版本开始:
    1.2
    作者:
    Robert Field, Neal Gafter (rewrite), Scott Seligman (generics, annotations)
